name: Nomusa Nkosi
bio:
Nomusa Nkosi's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Trained as a mechanical engineer, she initially worked in the automotive industry, but a chance encounter with a racing team needing simulation expertise led her down a different path. She discovered a passion for optimizing performance through virtual testing and quickly became a valuable asset. 

Nomusa's approach to simulator engineering is meticulous and data-driven. She believes in constantly refining the models to accurately reflect real-world conditions, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in simulation. Her demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to excellence; she expects the same level of dedication from her colleagues, always striving for marginal gains that can make a difference on the track. She is highly respected for her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and race engineers.

physical.hairStyle: short, tightly coiled afro, often with a few silver strands visible
physical.description: Nomusa is a woman of sturdy build with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Insists on a specific brand of rooibos tea, brewed precisely.
Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively working on the simulator.
Has a collection of miniature racing cars on her desk, each representing a significant race win.
